inputs.xtext_rule_text:
OwnedReferenceSubsetting returns SysML::ReferenceSubsetting :
	  referencedFeature = [SysML::Feature|QualifiedName]
	| ownedRelatedElement += OwnedFeatureChain
;

decision: As SysML 8.2.2.6.5 states it: `referencedFeature = [QualifiedName]`, or `referencedFeature = OwnedFeatureChain` with the chain owned by the relationship. The cross-reference parses a QualifiedName. The `{ ownedRelatedElement += ... }` action consumes no tokens. This is the SysML variant (ADR-0014). The Xtext states the same two alternatives. The clause writes the action as `{ ownedRelatedElement += referenceFeature }`, naming `referenceFeature` where the property is `referencedFeature`. The action consumes no tokens, so the rule is unaffected. Whether OMG has filed this was not searched.

evidence.note: OwnedReferenceSubsetting : ReferenceSubsetting = referencedFeature = [QualifiedName] | referencedFeature = OwnedFeatureChain { ownedRelatedElement += ... }
OwnedReferenceSubsetting: referencedFeature = [SysML::... | QualifiedName] | ownedRelatedElement += OwnedFeatureChain. Agrees.
